info.title: Conexus Product API
info.description: The Product HTTP API, emitted from the operations of @conexus/contract.

get.summary: Read the signed in account, whether it administers the installation, and its Workspaces.

delete.summary: End the Hub session of this browser, its Previews with it, and ask Keycloak to end its own.

get.summary: Read the members and the invitations of a Workspace, and the reader's own role.

post.summary: Invite an email into a Workspace with a role; the pair is the natural key, so a new invitation of the same email refreshes it. Owner only.

delete.summary: Remove a member from a Workspace, which withdraws every right the membership gave. An owner removes anyone; a member removes only themselves.

put.summary: Set the role of a member of a Workspace; the Workspace keeps at least one owner. Owner only.

delete.summary: Cancel an invitation into a Workspace that nobody has claimed. Owner only.

get.summary: Read the address of a Project's application and who may use it besides the members of its Workspace. Owner only.

post.summary: Invite an email to a Project's application; the first grant fixes the application's address. The person's next sign in claims it. Owner only.

delete.summary: Revoke a person's grant to a Project's application; their next request to it is refused. Owner only.
Cancel an invitation to a Project's application that nobody has claimed. Owner only.

get.summary: List the installation administrators and how each became one; installation administrator only.

post.summary: Make the one active account with this email an installation administrator; installation administrator only.

delete.summary: End an account's tenure as installation administrator; the installation keeps at least one. Installation administrator only.

post.summary: Create a Workspace; the creator becomes its owner.

get.summary: List the Projects of a Workspace.

post.summary: Create a Project with its source and initial access, once per idempotency key.

get.summary: Read one Project the Account may open.

delete.summary: Delete a Project, its data and its repository; installation administrator only.

get.summary: List the Projects of a Workspace with their latest Builder activity and whether a Preview exists.
Read the captured thumbnail of a Project application, as an image.
List the Connections of a Workspace without any credential field; installation administrator only.

post.summary: Create a Connection of a Workspace, idempotent on its client-chosen id; installation administrator only.
Check a Connection by running the allow-listed authentication of its Connector; installation administrator only.

delete.summary: Disable a Connection and end its open bindings; installation administrator only.

get.summary: List the open bindings of a Project and the Connections it could still bind; Workspace Owner only.

post.summary: Bind an enabled Connection of the Workspace to a Project under a Project-local name; Workspace Owner only.

delete.summary: End the binding of a Connection to a Project; Workspace Owner only.

get.summary: List the source tree of a Project at one exact source revision.
Read one source file of a Project at one exact source revision.
Read the Builder session of a Project: its thread and its latest run and Preview.

post.summary: Send a message to the Builder of a Project, which starts a run.
Cancel a Builder run; repeating the request changes nothing.

get.summary: Read the safe trace projection of one Builder run.
Compare two source revisions of a Project, without file content.

post.summary: Launch the Preview of the last good build of a Project.

get.summary: List the models the Builder picker offers the current Account.
List the model accounts of the current Account.

put.summary: Store the API key of the current Account for a provider.

post.summary: Start the Claude sign-in of the current Account.
Complete a Claude sign-in attempt of the current Account.
Start the ChatGPT sign-in of the current Account.
Poll a ChatGPT sign-in attempt of the current Account.

get.summary: Read the Google connection of the current Account.

post.summary: Start the Google sign-in of the current Account.
Complete a Google sign-in attempt of the current Account.
Read the status of a Google sign-in attempt of the current Account.

ConexusSession.name: __Host-conexus_session
ConexusSession.description: Opaque server-owned Conexus session. The cookie is Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, with no Domain attribute.
